name: 77067 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77067 (Houston) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (48% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77067 (Houston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77067 (Houston) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
